upgrades.name: Atmospheric Momentum
upgrades.description: Each civilization remembers a little more than the last. +10% production per level.

upgrades.name: Industrial Memory
upgrades.description: Start every future Earth already knowing the Steam Engine.

upgrades.name: Rapid Research
upgrades.description: Institutional knowledge survives the reset. +50% Research per level.

upgrades.name: Institutional Memory
upgrades.description: Every civilization inherits the last one's blueprints. Every building you own produces +40% more, per level.

upgrades.name: Civilizational Acceleration
upgrades.description: Blueprints from past civilizations make every technology 20% cheaper per level.

upgrades.name: Anthropocene Mastery
upgrades.description: You've done this before. ×10 all greenhouse-gas production.

upgrades.name: Eternal Flame
upgrades.description: An ember carried between worlds. Every future Earth starts with its fires already burning: +2 Natural Fire per level.

upgrades.name: Extended Endurance
upgrades.description: Your civilizations keep running longer without you watching. +100% offline progress cap per level.

upgrades.name: Head Start
upgrades.description: Begin each Earth with a stockpile of Energy, skipping the slowest opening minutes.

upgrades.name: Automated Industry
upgrades.description: Robots keep the lines running while you sleep. +100% offline progress cap, and every future Earth starts with 25 Natural Fires already lit.

upgrades.name: Deep Foundations
upgrades.description: Start every future Earth with a Research head start, so the tree opens immediately instead of after the first hour.
